caption: The drawing depicts twelve round buttons, arranged vertically in three symmetrical columns against a beige background. The left column, from top to bottom, includes a small blue button with gold highlights, a larger pink button with a gold floral border, a black button featuring a floral design within a gold frame, and a gold button with a figure or coat of arms. The right column, from top to bottom, features a red button with a gold plant motif, a button with white, green, and orange circular patterns on gold, a purple button with gold and white floral embellishments, and a gold button displaying a figure or possibly a pair of objects. The central column from top to bottom contains a small brownish-black button with a gold crescent moon and star, a large centrally placed black button with an engraved scene or figures, a small gold and silver button with a central leaf design, a button with a green, blue, and purple motif on a gold background, and finally, a button with a red and gold symmetrical design with a silver border. The drawing is signed “I. Steinberg” in gray writing in the lower left-hand side.
title: Buttons
